source.name: Rugby Database
source.note: The New Zealand team games list includes tour matches against provinces. This file keeps games on Rugby Database's Test match list. Women's matches, XV sides, and invitational sides are not in the model history. All Blacks is stored as New Zealand. Western Samoa is stored as Samoa. A free rugbyAPI key only covers yesterday onward, so it is not this history.

tourMatchesExcluded.note: Stormers, Sharks, Bulls and Lions in 2026 are on the New Zealand games list and are not Tests.
